pages.text: The Iron Band is a simple crafting component: a ring of iron around a source of heat. It is not worn on its own; it is the base for the mod's rings and bands.$(br2)$(l)How to get it:$() 8 iron ingots around a lava bucket (or a Volcanite Amulet, which is returned).$(br2)$(l)Using it:$() craft it into the Ignition Ring, Zero Ring, Harvest Goddess Band, Swiftwolf's Rending Gale and the other rings.$(br2)$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br2)$(li)It has no active power of its own.$(li)Like any item with a value, it can be learned and burned for EMC.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() none specific.
